note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 31 May 1911: six contests. "The Newry No. 2 Rural District Council now consists of the following 24 elected members (two for each division)" (Newry Reporter, 3 June 1911, p. 7). No party labels are printed. Polled 31 May 1911; declared on Thursday 1 June at the Newry Workhouse by W. R. Bell, deputy returning officer. Two seats; the figures are the candidate totals. M'Guill and Finnegan were the sitting members; Thomas M'Kinley withdrew. Printed "Jonesboro'". Finegan announced that he intended to lodge an objection to the return of Murphy. 280 votes recorded (including 3 spoilt) of 402 on the register.
